sources.title: jsbaicenter/JSBAI-Coder-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: JSBAI-Coder-4B is a 4B-parameter model, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-4B, that investigates bugs, edits files, runs commands, and verifies its own fixes in real software repositories.
